systemic_risk.message: Trading bot, coachvision are all showing risk signals in the same run. That many independently-run projects going wrong at once is more likely one shared cause — a cloud runner outage, an expired API key, a billing lapse — than several unrelated problems. Worth checking for that before triaging each one separately.
